name: Scheduled Jobs
description: List AnythingLLM's scheduled jobs (times in the user's zone, one-offs marked, missed ones flagged), or delete or disable one by its id. Delete and disable show the job first: show the user, and call again with apply: true only if they agree. Jobs the repo manages (Daily News Page) and a job that's running are refused.
author: anything

id.description: The job's id, from list; for delete and disable.

apply.description: true to delete or disable, once the user agrees.
